english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a person, object, or note that reminds you of something.

examples.english: This photo is a reminder not to forget my original aspiration.
examples.traditional: 張相係我嘅提醒，叫我唔好忘記初心。
examples.jyutping: zoeng1 soeng2 hai6 ngo5 ge3 tai4 sing2 giu3 ngo5 m4 hou2 mong4 gei3 co1 sam1
